 Profile Manage Profile Email Preferences Sign Out NBC Insider Saturday Night Live Is Saturday Night Live New Tonight? About the October 24 Host &Musical Guest
 The 52nd season of SNL is in full swing — here's what on tap for tonight.
 By Chris Phelan Oct 24, 2026, 10:00 AM ET Wide Dating Show Now Playing 5:38 Web Exclusive Wide Dating Show 13:34 Highlight Weekend Update ft. James Austin Johnson and Ashley Padilla 3:48 Highlight ROSALÍA: Reliquia (Live) Share this on Reddit Share this on Facebook Share this on X Share this by Email Share this by SMS Copy link Add us on Google You can't say James Austin Johnson isn't making the most of Saturday Night Live 's brief October hiatus. The Season 52 cast member made a stunning cross-cast cameo on the most recent episode of Saturday Night Live UK .
 How to Watch
 Watch Saturday Night Live  Saturdays at 11:30 p.m. ET on NBC and next day on Peacock.
 Stream Now on Johnson debuted his now-famous President Trump impression during SNL UK 's October 17 cold open . 
 In "President Trump and Andy Burnham’s Job Swap," Johnson's Trumps interrupts a meeting between UK Prime Minister Andy Burnham ( SNL UK cast member George Fouracres) and Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelensky (Freddie Meredith). He pitches a plan that would see Trump and Burnham switch roles.
 "I take over the UK, you take America," Trump explained. "I tell you, that place is a real mess, you're gonna hate it! It's an awful, awful job. It's a terrible place filled with disgusting people, I don't know what the hell happened."
 "I can't swap jobs with you now! I barely even started, people don't even hate me yet," Fouracre's Burnham protested.
 Johnson gave overseas viewers the full Trump impression experience , showing off his pitch-perfect vocal inflection and delivering plenty of absurd-yet-realistic musings as he complained about everything UK-related.
 "And how about that tiger, folks? Big tiger problems, gobbling your guys up," Trump vamped, referencing the man who died after entering a wildlife park's tiger enclosure on October 10. "I'm team tiger. I like all orange predators. Game recognize game. Orange predator solidarity."
 Talk about a crossover moment. Watch it here . 
 So, what's on tap for tonight for viewers in the United States? We've got all the details on tonight's Host and Musical Guest for the show airing at 11:30 p.m. ET on NBC and Peacock. 
 RELATED: The SNL Season 52 Cast: The Full List for 2026-2027 
 Is there a new episode of SNL tonight, October 24, 2026? 
 No. Next week kicks off the next run, with the Halloween episode hosted by Obsession star Inde Navarrette . 
 Who is the SNL Host for October 24 episode?
 Host Dakota Johnson and special guest Taylor Swift during the Saturday Night Live monologue on Saturday, October 3, 2026.
 Photo: Will Heath/NBC Actress Dakota Johnson is hosting tonight in a re-air of the October 3, 2026 show.
 The episode marked the Verity star's third time as Host . Johnson debuted in Season 40 on February 28, 2015, returning in Season 49 on January 27, 2024 .
 The star is the daughter of actor Don Johnson and Season 14 Host Melanie Griffith .
 RELATED: Watch Dakota Johnson's SNL Sketches & Monologue with Taylor Swift from October 3 
 In addition, tonight's show is notable for a memorable cameo by pop star Taylor Swift , who crashed Johnson's opening monologue after the Fifty Shades actress bemoaned her current love life.
 RELATED: Dakota Johnson Is Scathingly Funny in SNL's "Mean, Scary Girlfriend" Sketch 
 Who is Musical Guest for tonight's October 24 SNL episode?
 The Band Turnstile holds the Grammys for Best Rock Album - NEVER ENOUGH and Best Metal Performance - BIRDS at the 68th Grammy Awards in Los Angeles, CA, Sunday, Feb. 1, 2026. 
 Photo: Getty Images Turnstile is tonight's Musical Guest .
 The Baltimore rockers whose genre-bending sound incorporates elements of melodic hardcore, metal, and pop, will take the stage for the first time. Turnstile, formed in 2010, will perform their single "Birds" and a medley of "I Care" and "Dull," all tracks from their latest studio album, Never Enough .
 RELATED: Everything to Know About the Band Turnstile 
 RELATED: Every Host of Saturday Night Live Season 52 
 The band is currently in the middle of their The Never Enough Tour Pt. 2 , playing venues across the United States before heading overseas next year for stops across Europe.
 In order to accommodate their long-awaited SNL debut, Turnstile actually had to postpone their scheduled October 3 tour stop in Oklahoma City to the following Monday.

 NBC Turns 100 This Year! On November 15, 1926, NBC aired its first broadcast — and for 100 years, the network has helped define news , sports , and entertainment . Whether you’re starting your mornings with TODAY , laughing on weekends with SNL , or catching the big game on Sundays , NBC has been part of people’s lives for generations. Now in 2026, we're celebrating a century of shared moments, memories, and milestones. A century together. 
 Stay tuned to NBC this fall for stories honoring the shows, characters, and moments you love — both past and present. Because after 100 years, we’re only getting started. Don't forget to stream all your NBC favorites on Peacock right now.
